title_en: This Tree Is Older Than the Pyramids #Shorts
desc_en:
Methuselah, a bristlecone pine in California's White Mountains, is about 4,855 years old. It sprouted before the Great Pyramid was finished. Cold, dry, high ground makes it grow very slowly, with dense wood that resists decay.

Sources: Guinness World Records; Wikipedia; WorldAtlas.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
